Greetings. I'll try to keep this organised since I know support teams read hundreds of these. First, the background: I'm a small-café owner and I've been buying bulk coffee filters, paper cups and napkins from your business section for about eight months. I usually order every second Monday and it arrives Wednesday.

Second, the problem: the last two deliveries have been short. Two weeks ago, I ordered ten sleeves of cups and only got eight. I figured it was a one-off and emailed, and you were kind enough to send the missing two the following week. Then this Monday's order came in and again I was short, this time the napkins, where I received three cartons instead of five. It's getting expensive because I can't open on Thursday with no napkins and have to make emergency runs to the supermarket.

Third, what I've checked: I counted everything on delivery with the driver present both times, so I'm confident about the shortfall. I also checked the invoice, and it charged me for the full quantity both times.

What I'd like is a corrected invoice or credit for the missing napkins, and the two cartons delivered as quickly as you can manage, ideally before Thursday morning. I'd also love to know if the warehouse can double check my standing order, in case there's an error in how the quantities are stored. Thank you, I really do value the service otherwise.

Hello, I'm writing about a recurring headache with my internet-connected doorbell, which I bought through your smart-home section. It's the Gatekeeper Ring-Lite, installed in May. For the first couple of months it worked beautifully, I got notifications on my phone every time someone approached, and the video was clear enough to read the licence plate on the van across the street.

In August, the notifications began arriving minutes late, and sometimes not at all. I spoke to the manufacturer's helpline, and they suggested moving my Wi-Fi router closer, so I moved it to the hallway. That didn't help. Then they told me to reset the device, which I did, and it worked for four days before the lag came back. I've also updated the firmware twice, and the app is on the latest version.

I've now spent roughly ten hours on this, and I'm beginning to think the unit itself is faulty. The manufacturer said that since I bought it from you, I should go through your store for an exchange, as it's still within the first six months.

Could you tell me whether you'd replace it or refund it? I'd prefer a replacement of the same model, as I like the design, but I'd consider a different brand if there's one with a similar feature set. I can provide the serial number, my order number, and screenshots of the troubleshooting I've done. Thank you for your time.

Hello. I want to tell you about the trouble I've had with a garden shed delivery, because it's been a saga and I could use some resolution. I ordered a Fernbrook six-by-four shed on the 5th of September, with delivery scheduled for the 19th. The delivery company called on the morning of the 19th to say they'd arrive between noon and four. I took the day off work.

Nobody came. At half past four I called the company, and they said the driver had decided the access was too narrow and gone home. But our side gate is a metre wide, which is well within the dimensions stated on your site, and nobody ever called to check or knock. They rescheduled for the 26th. I took another day off, and this time they did come, but the driver said the panels were damaged in transit and refused to unload them, because he didn't want to be held liable.

So now it's the 4th of October, I still don't have a shed, I've used two days of annual leave, and I've received no clear update from you. The money was taken at the time of ordering. I don't know whether to wait for a third attempt or ask for my money back.

I think the fairest thing is a new delivery with a firm time slot and compensation for my lost leave, or else a full refund. Please let me know which options you can give me and how quickly. A direct phone number for the delivery team would also help a lot.

Good evening, I would like to ask for help with a refund that has been promised several times and never delivered. Back in July I returned a printer, the Inkwell Pro 300, because it kept jamming. I got a return authorisation, packed it carefully in the original box, and dropped it at a collection point. The tracking confirmed it arrived at your facility on the 29th of July.

On the 3rd of August, I received an email saying that the refund of one hundred and forty-nine dollars had been processed and would appear within five to ten business days. Weeks passed and there was nothing. I called my bank and they said no such credit had been received. I contacted your support in late August, and an agent said it was probably a delay and to wait another week. I waited. In September, I contacted you again and another agent said that the refund had been issued as a store credit instead, which I did not request and which isn't visible in my account.

I've looked in my account under every section and see no balance anywhere. Nothing in my emails mentions store credit either.

I need my money back, ideally to the original card. If it really was issued as store credit, I would like it converted back to a card refund, or at least shown in my account so I can use it. I'd appreciate a firm answer with a reference number, and a date by which I'll see the money. This has gone on far too long.

Hello, I'd like to raise a concern about a recent delivery driver and the way my parcel was left. I live in a ground-floor flat in a shared building, and on the 1st of October I ordered a set of kitchen knives, a block and a sharpening steel. The delivery was due on the 3rd. I received a notification that said it had been delivered at 11:02, with a photo of the parcel by the main entrance of the building, outside the communal door.

The photo shows the box sitting in the rain, with the corner soaked. I was at work. When I got home at six, the box was gone. My neighbours say they didn't see it. The communal door isn't always locked, and I suspect someone took it.

I'm a bit upset because the delivery instructions on my account say clearly, "please leave with the concierge at number 4 or return to depot." I set it up that way specifically because parcels have gone missing before. It seems that instruction was ignored. I've looked at the proof-of-delivery photo and there's no sign of the concierge's door.

I'd like a replacement sent, or a refund, whichever is quickest, since the parcel was never received by me. Please also make sure the delivery instruction is passed on properly to the courier next time. I can share the photo, my account notes and the order number. Thank you in advance.
